name: Hypnotic Kaamo
summary:
Meet Kaamo, a snake who is eager to give you a good look in the eye, but his intentions may not be so pure. This short game allows you to immerse yourself, up close and personal, with the hypnotic snake. Avoid his gaze by turning your head, covering your eyes... or just smacking him away!

Beware, Kaamo learns. He observes what movements catch your attention the most and slowly adapts to your playstyle. Keep relying on the same tricks, and he may find a way around them. Stay unpredictable, and for your own
